select a.*, b.*, d.dict_note as analyseTypeName, e.analyse_type as analyseType, e.algorithm_name as algorithmName, f.camera_name as cameraName from t_camera_preset a left join t_algorithm_conf b on a.preset_id = b.preset_id left join t_algorithm_info e on b.algorithm_id=e.algorithm_id left join t_camera_info f on f.camera_id = a.camera_id left join t_dict_business d on d.dict_code = e.analyse_type WHERE 1 = 1 and b.config_name like concat('%',#{configName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') and f.camera_id = #{cameraId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and e.analyse_type = #{analyseType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.preset_name like concat('%',#{presetName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') order by a.preset_id desc
